newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY ENDS STRONGER AS C.BANK REFRAINS FROM ACTION.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY ENDS STRONGER AS C.BANK REFRAINS FROM ACTION.

text.p: 1230 GMT - The Polish zloty, charged by inflows into Bank Handlowy's IPO, closed at 1.58/1.53 pct from the trading band centre, up from Tuesday's 1.52/1.50 pct as the c.bank refrained from intervening on the market for the first time this week.
* It closed at 3.2367/77 to the dollar, up from 3.2440/46 on Tuesday and at 1.8741/54 to the mark, down from 1.8693/98.
* O/N close at 21.60/21.80 vs opening 21.70/21.90. T/N at 21.65/21.85 vs 21.75/21.95. 52-week T-bill yield up to 21.56 at Wednesday auction. Poland offers 1.3 bln T-bills on Monday.
